page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c1m4.large is a burstable, x86_64-based virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz, featuring 2 physical cores and 2 vCPUs. The hardware configuration includes 8.0 GB of system memory, which provides 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and its baseline network bandwidth is specified at 0 Gbps.

Benchmark results place this server in the lower performance tiers. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score is 1161.28, and the multi-core score is 2371.48, both categorized in the bottom 25%. Memory performance is also limited, with a read-only large block bandwidth of 22.38 GB/sec and a Passmark memory score of 1168.91, both falling in the bottom 10%. Geekbench testing yields a single-core score of 1092.0 and a multi-core score of 1822.0, reflecting its entry-level compute capabilities.

Due to its burstable CPU allocation and lower-tier performance metrics, the ecs.t6-c1m4.large is a cost-effective option for workloads with variable or low CPU utilization. It is suitable for low-traffic web serving, basic text processing, development environments, and light background tasks that do not require sustained compute or high memory bandwidth.
